title: What You'll Get in This Course
summary: Promotional course trailer. It outlines the scope of the bootcamp (HTML through to React and the back end), the project-based format, and who the course is aimed at. No code is shown.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Instructor: Angela Yu, lead instructor at the London App Brewery. The online course follows the same curriculum as their 12-week in-person bootcamp.
Format: roughly 55+ hours of video plus step-by-step tutorials, interactive coding exercises and quizzes.
Scope runs from front end (HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript) to back end (Node) and React, with the MERN stack mentioned as part of the full-stack path.

Everything is taught through projects. Examples named in the trailer: a product website built with HTML/CSS/Bootstrap, games, a drum-kit music app, plus portfolio-friendly projects such as a to-do list and a project-management tool.
No prior programming experience is assumed. Experienced developers are told to check the downloadable curriculum and start at whatever section fits their level.
The stated aim is to teach the reasoning behind each step as well as the steps themselves.

playground.coverage: No playground lesson yet (trailer only, nothing to cover).
